Game Overview

StaxFall is a arcade title where defy gravity's whims and test your stacking skills with StaxFall. Build towering structures using unpredictable blocks, challenging your timing and strategic thinking. Keep stacking each shape on a teetering platform, and aim for the sky before the inevitable fall decides your fate. How high can you go before it all collapses?
